simple.summary: כְּלוּלָה (kᵉlûwlâh) means bridehood (only in the plural) First listed occurrence: Jer 2 2.

definitions.full: H3623. kelulah [ כְּלוּלָה ] noun feminine betrothal ; — only plural כְּלוּלֹתָ֑יִךְ (compare ' espousals ' ) Jer 2:2 thy betrothal-time (|| נְעוּרַיִךְ ).
